summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of a US$1.5 billion dual-tranche convertible bond offering. The offering consists of US$750 million in zero-coupon 5-year bonds due 2031 and US$750 million in 0.625% 7-year bonds due 2033, both issued at 100% of principal. Initial conversion prices are US$119.9813 (55% premium) and US$121.9165 (57.5% premium). Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including redemption of outstanding 2027 convertible bonds. Settlement is expected June 23, 2026. This is a routine refinancing event, not a special situation.
